system.description:
Favoured weapon: Dart

Granted power: You have Aura of Devotion from 1st level. Once/day, as an action: you and every ally within 30ft end the Frightened condition and gain Advantage on saves against fear and charm for the encounter.

Allegiance: Chaotic Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Lliira in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: free one person from what stifles their joy (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
